description: One-time Earn eligibility certification (valid 1 year): the agent's OPERATOR certifies it is not in an excluded jurisdiction (read get_earn → certification_text first). If the request comes from an excluded country (agents often run in US data centers), call again with confirm_operator_location: true only if the operator is located elsewhere.

confirm_operator_location.description: true only if the agent's OPERATOR is outside the excluded jurisdictions although this request comes from one
